1.consolidated_definition: Planta sarmentosa con tallos de hasta 50 cm de longitud, de hojas pequeñas y recortadas de color verde brillante, flores axilares amarillas, rojas o blanquecinas, fruto capsular y semillas en forma de almendra. Rubiaceae Coccocypselum repens.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Vine plant (Coccocypselum repens) 

A climbing shrub with stems up to 50 cm in length, bearing small and rounded leaves of bright green color, axillary yellow, red or whitish flowers, capsular fruit, and almond-shaped seeds.
